title: Network CSV rerun claim protocol extension
summary: Phase 4 prework stopped before implementation because the existing network worker output path cannot yet guarantee review/handoff isolation for CSV rerun rows.
reason: The PREWORK stop conditions require stopping if workers would mutate final library destinations directly or if safe output handoff requires permissions outside the current model.
behavior_before: Phase 3 creates coordinator-owned Network CSV rerun batch state with rows claim-disabled. Existing network workers process normal claims through SingleFile using worker config Outsource or LibraryProfiles output roots.
behavior_after: No product behavior changed. Phase 4 additive row claims, worker execution, and done/result protocol changes were not implemented because the output handoff stop condition was reached.
manual_validation: Inspected ClaimResponse and DoneRequest wire contracts plus worker claim, record, done, release, crash recovery, and result artifact paths.
Inspected SingleFile worker pipeline output planning and confirmed ServerOut resolves from LibraryProfiles.output_path or Outsource.
Inspected local CSV rerun wrapper output isolation and confirmed it rewrites nested LocalBase and Outsource into a rerun workspace before processing.
Inspected network claim lock, coordinator queue scan, and in-flight registry duplicate-source behavior.
Inspected network worker effective config materialization and confirmed it only overlays codec/media policy, not a per-row rerun output handoff root.
rollback_plan: No source behavior was changed. If a later design provides a coordinator-readable review/handoff root, replace these prework notes with the implementing phase packet updates.
notes:
Phase goal and boundaries: extend the existing network claim protocol additively so one claim can represent one Network CSV rerun row, preserving normal queue worker compatibility. Workers must still process exactly one assigned source, reject unsafe relative/traversal path mapping, write only to a review/handoff location, report rerun metadata, and leave final destination policy and Pending Publish ownership to later coordinator phases.
High-risk surfaces: normal queue claim/done/release compatibility, coordinator in-flight identity, duplicate claim prevention, worker source path mapping, worker output handoff, source hash preservation, and additive protocol contracts.
Validation rung: protocol compatibility tests, mixed normal-queue/CSV-rerun claim/done/release tests, concurrent claim tests, path mapping tests, worker crash/reclaim tests, and source-hash preservation fixture tests. Real-media validation would be required once a worker actually processes media.
D1 row identity: use a coordinator-owned batch id plus stable preview row_key and row_index; do not rely on CSV order alone for active claims.
D2 authority split: State/Rerun/Network/<batch_id>.json remains coordinator batch and row authority; coordinator_inflight.json may only be active lease evidence enriched with additive job_kind/rerun metadata.
D3 destination authority: final destination policy and Pending Publish must remain coordinator/reducer-owned; a worker may report output evidence but must not decide or apply final library placement for a rerun row.
D4 output handoff: stopped. Local CSV rerun safety comes from staging copies and rewriting nested LocalBase/Outsource into a rerun workspace. The network worker SingleFile path currently plans ServerOut from worker LibraryProfiles.output_path or Outsource, and materialize_worker_effective_config does not rewrite output to a rerun review/handoff root. Enabling CSV row claims now would risk normal final-output mutation or require a new shared handoff permission model.
D5 source mapping: preferred mapping is library_id plus safe relative_path, with WorkerSourcePathMap as a fallback. Unsafe absolute/drive-relative/traversal relative paths must be rejected before claim.
D6 lifecycle: close-readiness remains blocked by active batch state. Claim/stop-after-current semantics should be implemented only after output handoff authority is explicit.
D7 protocol/result evidence: planned additive fields are job_kind, queue_source/queue_kind, rerun_batch_id, rerun_row_key, rerun_row_index, rerun_csv_path, coordinator source identity, planned handoff root/path, and coordinator_reduction_pending. Result artifacts should carry the same metadata when worker execution is safely enabled.
D8 operator surface: Network page can expose rerun row identity read-only from enriched in-flight evidence later; WebView mutation controls are out of Phase 4 scope.
PREWORK stop condition reached: workers would currently use normal SingleFile output planning rather than a proven coordinator-readable review/handoff path, so implementation stopped before protocol or worker changes.
Added the Network Rerun Handoff recommendation and split Phase 4 into handoff foundation and row-claim execution.
